title: Scarlet Skips
description:
Help Scarlet break out of her funk by helping her touch grass! 
Life can be hard, really hard, but like Scarlet, you can take it one jump at a time! 

• Timing is key! Scarlet Skips is played entirely with press, hold, and release inputs of a single button!

• Easy for anyone to pick up and play! 

• Nearly impossible to put down! 

• Level up and choose from 3 random power-ups in a completely original Rogue-Like upgrade system...

• 10 upgrade cards; Increase your jump height, add a jump-rope, set it on FIRE?!

• Upgrades can be stacked and combined into a virtually infinite number of configurations!

• Find your favorite builds and optimize for the perfect run! Or try your best with self-imposed limitations! 
You do you!  

• We worked hard to push Scarlet's animation system to be as dynamic, expressive, and adorable as possible!

• Using fancy Unreal Engine animation tools, Scarlet's movement is achieved by combining dozens of candid animations with logic-driven procedural movement, allowing her to respond dynamically to gameplay conditions!
description_short: Jump jump jump as much as you can in this silly 1-button Rogue-Like about skipping rope! Power up your jump ropes to help Scarlet jump higher, survive longer, and reach absurdly high scores! boing boing boing boing boing boing boing boing
